exposure: Maternal salivary cortisol levels in the third trimester
Area under the curve (AUC) of cortisol
cohort: 240 mother-infant dyads from the Maternal and Developmental Risks from Environmental and Social Stressors (MADRES) pregnancy cohort study, primarily Hispanic and low-income
finding: There were no significant associations between maternal cortisol levels in the third trimester and infant birth weight.
